content: अतिपत् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To pass over; neglect, omit, transgress. .²2 To fly by, beyond or over; to cross. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To delay, neglect; see अतिपात्य below. .²2 To disrespect, offend; ये सत्यमेव हि गुरूनतिपातयन्ति <ls>Mu. 3. 33</ls>. transgress, violate; अतिपातितकालसाधना <ls>Ki. 2. 42</ls>. .²3 To cause to fly past or by. .²4 To make ineffectual; संशमनमेवं संशोधनमतिपातयति <ls>Suśr.</ls> .²5 To snatch away, drag away.
